about.title: My Story
about.subtitle: From Olympic discipline to digital growth — a journey of focus, performance, and measurable impact.
about.paragraph1: I grew up in the water, chasing hundredths of a second. That pursuit of excellence took me to the Olympics, where I learned that discipline, resilience, and focus are everything.
about.paragraph2: When I transitioned from the pool to the world of digital marketing, I carried those same principles with me — only now, instead of chasing medals, I help businesses chase measurable growth.
